    """Return n distinct record ids, deterministic for a given seed.

    The same (n, seed) always gives the same list, in the same order.
    Uses no capabilities, so there is no clock, randomness or I/O.
    """

    post {x for x in out}.len() == n

    ex make_ids(n=3, seed=7).len() == 3

    a = seed % (p - 1) + 1
    b = seed % p
    out: list[int] = []

        out.append((a * r + b) % p + p * q)
